summary: An exposed knife near the counter edge creates an immediate laceration hazard.

hazards.title: Exposed knife near counter edge
hazards.detail: Chef knife is left exposed and close to the edge where it could easily be knocked off.
fixSteps: Store the knife in a block, magnetic strip, or protective sheath.
Keep sharp cutlery pushed back from all counter edges.

hazards.title: Unsecured kitchen runner
hazards.detail: Floor runner in the walk path lacks visible non-slip backing or corner grips.
fixSteps: Apply non-skid rug tape or place a non-slip pad beneath the rug.
Ensure runner edges stay completely flat against the floor.
